text: [EMPTY 21]

label: common_1220_hakase_01a
text: To stop the time machine, you will need to use\nthe professor’s ID, which has been embedded\r\nwithin the Scarlet Book.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_01b
text: To stop the time machine, you will need to use\nthe professor’s ID, which has been embedded\r\nwithin the Violet Book.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_02a
text: It was very like the professor to put the final key\nwe would need in that book, of all places.\r\nShe loved that volume since childhood.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_02b
text: It was very like the professor to put the final key\nwe would need in that book, of all places.\r\nHe loved that volume since childhood.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_03a
text: If you place the Scarlet Book upon the pedestal\nhere, you will be able to stop the time machine.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_03b
text: If you place the Violet Book upon the pedestal\nhere, you will be able to stop the time machine.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_04a
text: There is just one issue.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_04b
text: There is just one issue.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_05a
text: If you try to stop the machine, I will most likely\nattack you.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_05b
text: If you try to stop the machine, I will most likely\nattack you.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_06a
text: Artificial being that I am, my own desires can be\noverridden by the system’s programming.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_06b
text: Artificial being that I am, my own desires can be\noverridden by the system’s programming.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_07a
text: Once that happens, I’m afraid I will become no\nmore than a battle machine, bound to defeat\r\nanyone identified as an obstacle by my code.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_07b
text: Once that happens, I’m afraid I will become no\nmore than a battle machine, bound to defeat\r\nanyone identified as an obstacle by my code.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_08a
text: My battling abilities are peerless. They are built\nupon analysis of all the battles carried out by\r\nthe various Champions of the Paldea region.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_08b
text: My battling abilities are peerless. They are built\nupon analysis of all the battles carried out by\r\nthe various Champions of the Paldea region.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_09a
text: Having seen the bond between you and your\nPokémon, however, I believe you can prevail.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_09b
text: Having seen the bond between you and your\nPokémon, however, I believe you can prevail.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]

label: common_1220_hakase_10a
text: Once you have readied yourself for this fight,\nplease place the Scarlet Book upon the pedestal.[VAR 0x0114(000C)]

label: common_1220_hakase_10b
text: Once you have readied yourself for this fight,\nplease place the Violet Book upon the pedestal.[VAR 0x0114(000F)]
